metadata.description: The classic Goose Creek Golf Club, conveniently located in historic Leesburg, has been home to Northern Virginia's golfers for half a century. Goose Creek rekindles the spirit of days past, providing today's golfers a classic golfing experience at a great value. The Goose's well-known layout permits a quick pace of play, allowing more time to relax on the patio or in the Grille. The golf course is challenging from tee to green, and is designed to offer a fun and exciting challenge to golfers of all skill levels. The 18 hole, 6,444 yard, par 72 layout features three tee stations, winding fairways with strategically placed bunkers, ponds, creeks and trees, which provide a variety of golf challenges. A spacious clubhouse and outdoor patio provide the perfect place for hosting an outing or just relaxing after a great round of golf at Goose Creek.

metadata.description: Experience the award-winning Tom Jackson designed golf course at Stonewall Golf Club. Stretching just over 7,000 yards from the back tees, this par 72 championship course is skillfully designed to maintain the integrity and natural surroundings of this pristine setting. The course offers five sets of tees to offer golfers of all ability a challenging yet playable golf course. The front nine rambles through open land alongside the banks of Lake Manassas, while the contrasting back nine meanders through densely wooded hills. The course is tied together with artfully shaped bunkering and immaculate tees, fairways and greens.
